title: Great learning experience
text:
I had a great experience. The school is in a beautiful location, the teachers are friendly and professional, and the administrative staff is always helpful and efficient.

I started as a beginner and can now communicate confidently in Spanish.

Thank you for this wonderful experience. I highly recommend this school.
author: 939mark_taa

title: Expanish Course Barcelona
text: The new school is very nice (I had been to Expanish before but in the old campus). The Expanish staff is always friendly and ready to help us, whether teachers or administrative staff. Very nice experience, again.
